About Double Bay Disability Care

Everyday support, delivered with dignity and genuine care.

Double Bay Disability Care Pty Ltd is a nationally registered NDIS provider with operations in Queensland, New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia. We help people with disability live more independently, stay connected with their community and work towards the goals that matter to them.

  • Person-centred planning. Supports built around your goals, preferences and NDIS plan.
  • Experienced in complex needs. Skilled staff supporting people with high and changing needs.
  • Clear communication. We work closely with families, support coordinators and plan managers.

Complex Supports

See the person, not just a diagnosis.

People have different strengths, preferences and goals, even when they share the same diagnosis. We welcome enquiries from people living with complex conditions and work together to find the right everyday support, living arrangements and community connections.

Discuss Your Needs
Nurse supporting an adult participant at homeImage slot · replace with photo

Multiple Sclerosis (MS)

Mobility, fatigue-aware routines, personal care and community participation.

Acquired Brain Injury (ABI)

Everyday routines, cognitive supports, life skills and community re-engagement.

Young-onset Dementia

Familiar routines, daily activities, orientation and close family collaboration.

Psychosocial Disability

Recovery-oriented supports and independent living skills.

Youth Mental Health

Age-appropriate psychosocial supports for eligible young people.

Other Neurological Needs

Parkinson's, stroke, MND, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, spinal injury, autism and intellectual disability.

Support options are tailored to each person's goals, NDIS funding and assessed needs.

Contact Us
Is Double Bay Disability Care a registered NDIS provider?+

Yes. Double Bay Disability Care Pty Ltd is a nationally registered NDIS provider operating in Queensland, New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia.

Who can make a referral?+

Participants, families, carers, support coordinators, plan managers, hospital and clinical teams, and community organisations can all refer using our online referral form.

Do you support self-managed and plan-managed participants?+

Yes. We work with self-managed, plan-managed and NDIA-managed participants.

What is the difference between SIL and SDA?+

SIL (Supported Independent Living) is the support you receive at home. SDA (Specialist Disability Accommodation) is the home itself. We provide SIL and help you find SDA through verified housing partners.

How quickly can supports start?+

Once we receive your referral, our team will contact you to discuss your needs. Start times depend on your plan, location and the supports required.

Ready to talk about the right support?

Make a referral today or get in touch with our team. We're here to help you take the next step.
